protocol.title: Malaria Detection Using Inertial Microfluidics
protocol.objective: Label-free enrichment of ring-stage malaria parasites from lysed whole blood by inertial WBC depletion, enabling reliable qPCR-based detection at clinically relevant parasitemia levels (10^3-10^4 parasites/mL)

device.type: High-aspect-ratio rectangular microchannel with contraction-expansion array
device.configuration: Cascaded 2-stage system (3 biochips: 1 pressure compensator + 2 separation chips)
device.material: PDMS bonded to glass (oxygen plasma, Covance, Femto Science)
device.fabrication: Soft lithography; PDMS 10:1 Sylgard 184 baked 70 C for 2 h; 1.5 mm punch holes

inlets.single_inlet: Sample input (lysed diluted blood + free parasites)

reagents.rbc_lysis_buffer: eBioscience RBC lysis buffer (per manufacturer instructions)
reagents.sample_diluent: 1x PBS (0.25x final dilution of lysed blood, i.e. 4-fold dilution)
reagents.wbc_stain: APC-conjugated CD45 antibody (1:100, Miltenyi Biotec Asia Pacific)
reagents.malaria_culture_media: RPMI 1640 + 0.5% Albumax I + 2 mM L-glutamine + 50 ug/mL hypoxanthine + 25 ug/mL gentamicin at 2.5% hematocrit
reagents.synchronisation_agent: 5% sorbitol (applied every 2 days at ring stage)

operating_parameters.sensitivity_vs_microscopy: ~100-fold improvement over thick blood smear microscopy (50-100 parasites/uL)

steps.name: Blood draw and iRBC spiking
steps.notes: Spiked densities mimic clinically relevant low-level parasitemia (~2-10 iRBCs/uL). Calibration standards: 2k, 5k, 10k iRBCs/mL used for qPCR standard curve.

steps.name: RBC bulk lysis
steps.notes: eBioscience RBC lysis buffer per manufacturer instructions. Removes bulk erythrocyte population. iRBCs remain intact at this stage; parasites still encapsulated.

steps.name: Saponin lysis to release free parasites
steps.notes: Saponin selectively disrupts cholesterol-rich RBC/iRBC membranes; parasite membranes remain intact. Released parasites (1-2 um) are below the 4 um focusing cutoff and will not be focused in the separation channel.

steps.name: Centrifugation and PBS wash
steps.notes: 4-fold dilution is critical: reduces WBC-WBC interactions that degrade depletion efficiency. At 1x: ~47% depletion; at 0.25x: ~99.90% single-cycle depletion.

steps.name: Device priming
steps.notes: Primes PDMS channel surfaces; blocks non-specific cell/particle adhesion.

steps.name: Stage 1 inertial microfluidic separation
steps.wbc_focusing_mechanism: Shear-modulated inertial lift + wall-induced lift force equilibration drives WBCs (6-15 um) to sidewalls
steps.parasite_behavior: Free parasites (1-2 um, below 4 um cutoff) remain unfocused; distributed across all outlets
steps.detection_method: CD45-APC flow cytometry (BD Accuri C6) + Olympus IX81 epifluorescent microscope

steps.name: Stage 2 cascaded inertial microfluidic separation
steps.configuration: Cascaded Stage 2 chip fed from center outlet of Stage 1; pressure compensator chip in parallel
steps.wbc_reduction_vs_single_cycle: ~2000 additional WBCs removed vs single cycle
steps.detection_method: FACS collection efficiency of 1.5 um bead surrogates (BD Accuri C6 flow cytometer)

steps.name: Parasite DNA extraction
steps.notes: WBC removal upstream is critical: residual WBC DNA cross-reacts with p.f.-specific primers; PCR inhibitors in WBC genomic material suppress amplification. Without enrichment, 2k/mL parasitemia is undetectable by qPCR.

steps.name: qPCR amplification and detection
steps.primer_specificity: Confirmed by melt curve (two peaks: spiked iRBCs + isoC internal control from Norgen kit)
steps.recovery_calculation: DNA from enriched sample / DNA from same count unenriched parasites x 100

results.qpcr_signal_fold_increase_with_enrichmen: ~2-fold increase in Ct signal vs unenriched

fail.action: drain(qPCRMix); below detection limit or residual inhibition

separation_physics.drag_force: Viscous drag entrains particles along flow streamlines
separation_physics.inertial_lift_force: Responsible for lateral migration of particles across flow streamlines
separation_physics.equilibrium: Balance of shear-modulated inertial lift and wall-induced lift drives particles to channel periphery
separation_physics.high_aspect_ratio_effect: High shear rate along channel width causes WBCs to migrate and align into two streams near sidewalls
separation_physics.parasite_behavior: Below 4 um cutoff; not focused; exits all outlets predominantly at center

vs_cd45_magnetic_beads.magnetic_particle_interference: Magnetic particles in enriched sample can significantly affect PCR results

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.description: Sample prep: blood draw, iRBC spike, RBC lysis, saponin lysis, PBS wash, device priming, Stage 1 separation

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_4_j
basic_blocks.description: Dispose wbcSignal1; Stage 2 cascaded separation begins

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_7_j
basic_blocks.description: Dispose recoverySignal; DNA extraction and qPCR branch begins
